shots.description: Medium webcam frame, Halo can on counter; transcript streams right, Routine Analysis and loyalty tags pop, 'packaging catches my eye' highlights

Halo can (slim matte sand-beige 250ml, black HALO wordmark) on the counter. Talking naturally, relaxed, slight laughs. Lip-synced to Clip A.

shots.audio: Riya Clip A, jump-cut: 'Oh, it's a whole thing honestly. Weekdays I don't really have time to make it, so I just pick up a can on the way to work. I used to be loyal to one brand, but lately I've been trying new ones, mostly because the packaging is just... really nice now, so I end up picking whatever catches my eye.'

shots.description: Slow push-in on her face, glance away, brow pinch; face mesh fades on, sentiment line dips, 'Mismatch' tag
